name: Sand-Shrike

Traits.name: Ambusher
Traits.text: The sand-shrike ignores Difficult Terrain, and Opportunity Attacks against it are made with Disadvantage.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The sand-shrike makes two Claw attacks.

Actions.name: Claw
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 22 (4d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

Actions.name: Sand Burst (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 15, each creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* 21 (6d6) Slashing damage, and the target has the Prone condition.
Actions.clause: is only dangerous on the turn after it goes still

Bonus Actions.name: Nimble Escape
Bonus Actions.text: The sand-shrike takes the Disengage or Hide action.

lore: A buried monstrosity that hoards still air in its thorax and spends it in one killing lunge, the sand-shrike wants only a steady supply of warmth that wanders too close to the dunes.
